caption: mars re-enters leo today, 14:15 utc, still retrograde. jupiter is retrograde in leo too.

slides.headline: *leo*, mars is back in your sign, walking backwards
*mars* slides back from virgo into leo
slides.body: mars left leo on nov 25. it's been retrograde since jan 10 and today it appears to back over the line. jupiter, also retrograde, is in leo with it.

slides.headline: you don't need to *win* the rematch
slides.body: old drive, old pride, old crush. look before you leap.

slides.headline: say it once, warmly. that's the *loud* move now.
